high_level_description: The image appears to be a behind-the-scenes photograph from the movie "Terminator 2: Judgment Day." It features two individuals standing side by side in what looks like a dimly lit, industrial or spaceship-like environment. People: On the left is a man with a beard and mustache, wearing a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt. He has his arms crossed and is looking slightly upwards. On the right is Arnold Schwarzenegger, dressed as the iconic Terminator character. He is wearing a black leather jacket, a gray shirt underneath, and has a cybernetic arm.
